description: This bar chart illustrates the number of factual errors across four different datasets—HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue, and IIRC—when evaluated using three different quality assurance (QA) methods: NoR QA, OneR QA, and IRCoT QA. The horizontal axis displays the dataset names in the order HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue, and IIRC. The vertical axis, labeled “Factual Errors,” has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, with tick marks at intervals of 5.  For each dataset, there are three bars representing the error counts for each QA method. The NoR QA results are represented by yellow bars, with values of 15 for HotpotQA, 28 for 2WikiMQA, 27 for MuSiQue, and 15 for IIRC. The OneR QA results are shown as red bars, with values of 10 for HotpotQA, 23 for 2WikiMQA, 23 for MuSiQue, and 14 for IIRC. Finally, the IRCoT QA results are displayed as blue, diagonally-patterned bars, with values of 5 for HotpotQA, 23 for 2WikiMQA, 11 for MuSiQue, and 14 for IIRC. The bars are grouped by dataset, with each QA method’s bar positioned adjacent to one another within each group.  The tallest bar is for NoR QA on the 2WikiMQA dataset, with a value of 28, while the shortest bar is for IRCoT QA on the HotpotQA dataset, with a value of 5.
